plan.title: bug(check): the cited-skip scan walks git-ignored nested worktrees, so release Step 5 fails in a maintainer checkout that CI passes

narratives.Description: The #6071 cited-skip scan and the #6072 sanctioned-skip baseline each walk test files with a private walkTestFiles copy that descends into git-ignored linked worktrees under .deft-scratch/worktrees. On a maintainer checkout with swarm worktrees, skips inside those worktrees fail release Step 5 even though CI passes. This story extracts one shared leaf walk helper that skips .deft-scratch and does not descend into subdirectories whose .git entry is a file, and routes both gates through it.
narratives.Overview:
1. Extract one shared test-file walk helper (leaf walk-enumeration module under `packages/core/src/check/`) and route both `gate-lists.ts` (`evaluateCitedSkipScan` / #6071) and `context.ts` (`runSanctionedSkipCountBaselineGate` / #6072) through it.
2. That helper skips directory name `.deft-scratch` and does not descend into a subdirectory whose `.git` entry is a **file** (linked worktree).
3. Keep sanctioned-skip detection and the #6072 baseline ratchet rules unchanged.
4. Do not switch v1 enumeration to `git ls-files`.
5. Do not close with twin in-place `walkTestFiles` edits as the Bound mechanism.
6. Do not merge duplicated inventory/scan/baseline tables as part of this close.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Add packages/core/src/check/walk-test-files.ts (node:fs/path only) with unit tests in walk-test-files.test.ts.
2. Delete the private walkTestFiles in gate-lists.ts and context.ts and call the shared helper from both inventoryCitedSkipsInTree copies.
3. Add a nested-worktree fixture to the #6071 describe in orchestrator.test.ts and the #6072 describe in degraded-skip.test.ts; build skip strings at runtime.
4. Add a CHANGELOG [Unreleased] Fixed entry.
narratives.UserStory: As a Directive maintainer, I want the cited-skip and sanctioned-skip gates to ignore linked worktrees under .deft-scratch, so that release Step 5 passes on my checkout whenever CI passes.

narrative.Acceptance: When gate-lists.ts and context.ts enumerate test files, both call the one shared helper in packages/core/src/check/walk-test-files.ts and no private walkTestFiles copy remains.

items.title: Keep sanctioned-skip detection and the #6072 baseline ratchet rules unchanged.

narrative.Acceptance: When a primary-tree test file holds an unsanctioned describe.skip, the gate still fails with unsanctioned-test-skip, and the baseline ratchet returns the same verdicts as before.

items.title: Do not switch v1 enumeration to `git ls-files`.

narrative.Acceptance: When the helper enumerates files it walks the filesystem with node:fs, and the diff shows no git ls-files call added to the enumeration path.

items.title: Do not close with twin in-place `walkTestFiles` edits as the Bound mechanism.

narrative.Acceptance: When reviewers inspect the diff, both gates import the shared helper; a change that only edits two walkTestFiles copies in place fails this clause.

items.title: Do not merge duplicated inventory/scan/baseline tables as part of this close.

narrative.Acceptance: When the change lands, the CITED_SKIP_BASELINE tables in gate-lists.ts and context.ts still exist separately and return the same entries as before.

Depends-on: #6071 cited-skip scanner (list-on-every-run); this issue owns only walk scope so ignored nested worktrees cannot fail the scan

## Bound remedy

In `packages/core/src/check/gate-lists.ts` `walkTestFiles`:
1. Skip the directory name `.deft-scratch` (same early-continue class as `node_modules` / `dist` / `.git`).
2. Before recursing into a subdirectory, if that subdirectory contains a `.git` **file** (linked worktree), do not descend.

Keep sanctioned-skip detection and #6072 baseline ratchet unchanged. Enumeration stays readdir-based; do not switch the v1 close to `git ls-files` (that would also drop untracked on-disk tests and widen the semantic change).

## Acceptance (issue)

- Checkout with a linked worktree under `.deft-scratch/worktrees/` that contains an unsanctioned skip passes when the primary tree's tracked files have none.
- An unsanctioned skip in a tracked file is still refused.
- CHANGELOG `[Unreleased]` entry.

## In plain English

Release Step 5 failed because `task check` walked into ignored swarm/arc worktrees and treated their test skips as part of this commit. Prefer-A stops the walk at those worktrees and at `.deft-scratch`, so local maintainer checkouts match CI for the same commit.

Failure mode: Release Step 5 / task check still couples readiness to ignored nested worktrees via the unbound twin.

Disposition consequence: remint ## Bound remedy so both live walks are bounded (shared helper or twin site list). Lean cannot bind as written.

Failure mode: future walk bounds drift again between #6071 and #6072.

### F3 git ls-files decline
footnote

Prefer-A correctly keeps readdir enumeration and declines git ls-files for v1 (would drop untracked on-disk tests). No disposition weight.

## Road not taken
Switching the v1 close to git ls-files (issue option A) would fix ignored-worktree coupling but widens semantics beyond Thin Fail-Closed #3265. Steelman: strongest rejected position is commit-exact enumeration; flip only if untracked test files must never participate in cited-skip inventory.

## In plain English
Prefer-A correctly stops the cited-skip walk at ignored worktrees for the #6071 gate, but the same broken walk still lives in context.ts for the #6072 baseline gate that also runs on task check. Binding the lean as written would fix one gate and leave the other able to fail release Step 5 on nested worktrees. Remint the bound remedy to cover both live walks.

metadata.issueBody:
## Problem

`task check`'s cited-skip scan (#6071) walks every directory under the project root on disk, including git-ignored ones. In a maintainer checkout that holds linked worktrees under `.deft-scratch/worktrees/`, it scans each worktree's copy of the test tree and refuses their skips. So the release's Step 5 fails on files that are not in the commit being released.

## Seen on this repo (2026-11-12, 0.129.7 cut)

- Release Step 5 ran `task check` in the primary checkout at master b9c53c28c.
- It refused 23 test skips. All 23 were under `.deft-scratch/worktrees/<name>/packages/core/...` (arc worktrees and story worktrees), for example:

```
check: unsanctioned-test-skip: .deft-scratch/worktrees/arc-5710/packages/core/src/release-e2e/legacy-bridge-leg.test.ts:410 describe.skip refused in v1 (#6071)
```

- None was outside `.deft-scratch/`.
- CI's `Merge gate (task check)` passed on the same commit, because CI's clean checkout has no nested worktrees.
- `.deft-scratch/worktrees` is git-ignored. Directive's own swarm and design-critique flows create worktrees there.

The workaround was to `git worktree move` the nested worktrees out of the checkout for the cut. Four of them could not move because they were still open as session folders in the desktop app.

## Where

`packages/core/src/check/gate-lists.ts`, `walkTestFiles`: it uses `readdirSync` recursively and skips only `node_modules`, `dist` and `.git`. It does not consult `.gitignore` and does not stop at a nested worktree (a directory whose `.git` is a file).

## Requested behaviour

- The scan covers the files of the commit under test, not whatever else is on disk. Options: enumerate with `git ls-files` (tracked plus staged), or stop descending at a directory whose `.git` entry is a file, and skip `.deft-scratch/`.
- Same result locally and in CI for the same commit.
- No change to what counts as a sanctioned skip.

## Acceptance

- A checkout with a linked worktree under `.deft-scratch/worktrees/` that contains an unsanctioned skip passes the scan when the checkout's own tracked files have none.
- An unsanctioned skip in a tracked file is still refused.
- CHANGELOG `[Unreleased]` entry.

## Related

#6071 (cited-skip scan), #6072 (skip-count baseline), #5954 (release-skill gaps from the 0.129.1 cut), #5912 (another release-preflight failure from the same cut).

expected_outputs: cited-skip-scan (#6071) and sanctioned-skip-count-baseline (#6072) pass when a linked worktree under .deft-scratch/worktrees holds an unrefused describe.skip
shared leaf walk helper with unit tests; .deft-scratch skipped by literal basename and .git-file subdirs not descended
